s: June 24, 2025 - Sort of a step up from Numi or Mighty Leaf, more like Adagio but at better prices. But if you are mostly drinking pure teas not blends or fruit flavored or herbal, then you can almost certainly do better by going to a bit better vendor and/or going directly to a specialist vendor. EG, Tao of Tea is probably a good place to buy “English Breakfast” and ”Gunpowder Green” and jasmine pearls and the like, but if you want dragonwell or sencha or a golden tippy Yunnan tea or a Taiwanese oolong or anything else that specific then there are better vendors.
